dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent reviewer confirms exact scope; current identity guard passes before any permitted diagnostic.
dependencies.action: Obtain a redacted product card and broker confirmation; independently verify the exact pinned installation at any later attachment.
dependencies.evidence_required: Dated Exness KE account-variant confirmation and matching masked server, account, symbol, mode and installation evidence.
dependencies.finding: Earlier terminal identity is dated. The exact product variant is unverified.
dependencies.required_resolution: Recheck installation and exact account at attachment and obtain redacted product confirmation.

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent reviewer reconciles the approved evaluator assumptions to dated executable evidence over the entire intended scope.
dependencies.action: Obtain dated exact-product rates and documentation of ordinary and exceptional execution.
dependencies.evidence_required: Commission and rounding, spread data, swaps/funding, margin and HMR tiers, conversion, stop-out and fill/slippage evidence.
dependencies.finding: Observed quotes and margin are point samples. Commission, swaps, funding, tariffs and fills are unverified.
dependencies.required_resolution: Obtain effective scoped spreads, commissions, swap/funding, margin tiers, slippage and fill evidence.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: Exness KE and independent execution reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent reconciliation passes the unchanged broker validator and resolves the known discrepancy without a larger tolerance.
dependencies.action: Request the rounding sequence, tie rules, and documented calculator-to-booking treatment at both sides of a cent boundary.
dependencies.evidence_required: Authoritative formula and booked-P/L examples for gains/losses, minimum volume, commission and partial closes.
dependencies.finding: 216 independent calculator results fit the empirical model. Booked P/L remains unverified.
dependencies.required_resolution: Obtain authoritative calculator/booking rules and reconcile the discrepancy with the unchanged validator.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: Exness KE / MetaQuotes and independent reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Validator finds a unique applicable interval, with explicit exceptional coverage and no unresolved overlaps or gaps.
dependencies.action: Obtain separate dated quote/trade calendars and a versioned exception feed for the exact product.
dependencies.evidence_required: UTC quote, open, close-only and restricted intervals, DST transitions, holidays, maintenance, closure and correction notices.
dependencies.finding: The public DST schedule does not establish exact quote or trade intervals for this account.
dependencies.required_resolution: Verify dated quote, trade and close-only permissions, DST, holidays, maintenance and exceptional closures.

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Unique mapping covers the whole bracket; existing freshness and close-boundary checks pass under the scoped clock evidence.
dependencies.action: Obtain effective-dated live and archive time semantics and capture independent clock brackets under existing diagnostic controls.
dependencies.evidence_required: Raw seconds/milliseconds, request/return semantics, transition samples, offset windows and independent UTC measurements.
dependencies.finding: The clock bracket supported conditional age estimates. No effective-dated production mapping exists.
dependencies.required_resolution: Obtain server-specific live and historical UTC semantics and verify full-bracket freshness and transition handling.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: Exness KE / MetaQuotes and time-evidence reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Existing historical validator admits the intended scope or explicitly limits it to research. All unexplained gaps remain outstanding.
dependencies.action: Obtain one bounded permitted sample first, independently review lineage and gaps, then check the target interval inventory.
dependencies.evidence_required: Source and account scope, rights, original hashes, bid/ask basis, UTC encoding, coverage and exception evidence.
dependencies.finding: No new research dataset or execution-grade history passed. Archived ticks are diagnostic only.
dependencies.required_resolution: Verify original bytes, reuse rights, UTC mapping, bid/ask basis, dated coverage and gaps with the existing validator.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: Data provider, data custodian and independent reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Existing risk-day check admits only the verified successor, and missing or conflicting evidence leaves latches in force.
dependencies.action: Approve an account-specific risk-day policy, then obtain a boundary equity observation independent of the collector.
dependencies.evidence_required: Exact UTC successor boundary, documented equity calculation and positive attested equity at that instant.
dependencies.finding: No approved daily reset or independently attested opening equity was recorded.
dependencies.required_resolution: Approve an exact account-scoped policy boundary and attest opening equity at that UTC instant.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: GoldBot operator and independent account-evidence reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Every admitted test entry fits the unchanged planner and free margin; rejected cases remain rejected and accounted for.
dependencies.action: Recheck the USD 3,000 reference with verified dates, costs, contract economics and existing risk limits.
dependencies.evidence_required: Minimum/step, validated stop geometry, actual budget and margin inputs, rejection reconciliation.
dependencies.finding: The USD 3,000 reference frequently fails minimum-lot risk checks, especially on H1.
dependencies.required_resolution: Verify actual contract/cost inputs and feasible scoped entries at the unchanged budget.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: GoldBot risk reviewer and Exness KE

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Phase 6.10.6 verifies strategy identity, scope, timing and nonoverlap, and the governing gate explicitly authorizes the permitted activity.
dependencies.action: Complete the exposure declaration; freeze the source, evaluator, environment, costs and dates; obtain independent receipts.
dependencies.evidence_required: Signed plan and prior UTC envelopes, pre-start registration, timely custody, full horizon and independently sealed intake.
dependencies.finding: The protocol is a draft. No trusted registration, verified exposure inventory or sealed intake is configured.
dependencies.required_resolution: Approve scope and fixed dates, independently precommit, verify nonoverlap and admit sealed intake under the existing protocol.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: GoldBot operator, independent registrar and data custodian

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: A candidate meets the independently approved thresholds on eligible unseen data. This finding alone grants no trading authority.
dependencies.action: Use the separately approved evaluator once on a valid sealed intake, reporting all eight cohorts together.
dependencies.evidence_required: Independent audit of each complete after-cost ledger, drawdown, sample count, and protocol violations.
dependencies.finding: Frozen retrospective outcomes do not demonstrate robust profitability.
dependencies.required_resolution: Obtain independently validated net-after-costs strategy results and risk compliance.

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent dry-run evidence passes, all applicable blockers are closed, and Phase 6.9.6 explicitly authorizes demo execution.
dependencies.action: Specify and separately verify the Phase 7 demo-only operating envelope and incident response after prerequisite gates clear.
dependencies.evidence_required: Pinned demo identity, risk and reconciliation drills, stop/kill and restart drills, logs, monitoring owner and rollback checklist.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: GoldBot operator and independent operations reviewer

dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Every live condition passes and Phase 6.9.6 grants explicit applicable execution authorization.
dependencies.action: Treat any live deployment as a distinct decision using live-account evidence and explicit authorization.
dependencies.evidence_required: Successful separately authorized demo evidence, independently verified live scope and signed live approval.
dependencies.responsible_or_dependency: GoldBot operator, live broker and independent risk reviewer
